Your  steadfast love extends to the heaven

Your  faithfulness reaches to the clouds

Your  righteousness is like majestic mountains

And  Your wisdom like the depths of the sea

And  you come to me.

Filling  my hear with Your loving kindness

I  find my strength in the shadow of your wings.

I  eat my fill from the abundance of Your household

And  I drink from the stream of rejoicing

You  are my king, You are my king.

title: CONSUME  ME LORD
lyrics:
Consume  me Lord, with the fire of Your Spirit.

Consume  me Lord, and make me more like you.

Break  me Lord, and bless the broken pieces of my  life

Let  me be used, Lord by you.

title: SHINE  JESUS SHINE
lyrics:
Shine  Jesus shine

Fill  this land with the Father’s glory

Blaze,  Spirit, blaze, set our hearts on fire

Flow  river flow, flood the nations with grace and mercy

Send  forth Your Word, Lord and let there be light.

title: JESUS  YOU’RE THE CENTRE OF MY JOY
lyrics:
Jesus,  You’re the center of my joy.

All  that’s good and perfect comes from You

You’re  the home of my salvation, over all I do.

Jesus,  You’re the center of my joy.

title: THINK  ABOUT HIS LOVE
lyrics:
Think  about His love, think about His goodness.

Think  about His love that’s brought us through.

It’s  as high as the heavens above.

So  great is the measure of our Father’s love.

Great  is the measure of our Father’s love.

title: JESUS  IS REAL TO ME
lyrics:
He’s  real, He’s real, Jesus is real to me

Oh  yes, He gives me the victory

So  many people doubt Him,

I  can’t live without Him

That’s  why I love Him so, He’s so real to me.

title: WE  ARE ONE BODY
lyrics:
Chorus

Though  we are many, we are one body

We  are one body in Christ

(Repeat 2X)

One  faith in the Lord Jesus Christ

Binding  us together in one cause

One  hope in the one god

One  Father over all

title: PEACE
lyrics:
I  will worship the Lord for He is worthy

I  will lay down my sword,

the Prince of Peace is His name

King  of the flood the Lord is mighty

The  Lord can quench the evil flame

Chorus

Peace  when trouble blows

Jehovah  sees, Jehovah knows

Gives  me peace when sorrow nears

Jehovah  sees, Jehovah hears

Like  the breath I need to live

Jehovah  takes, Jehovah gives

Gives  me peace when trouble blows

Jehovah  sees Jehovah knows

Yes,  He knows

title: OH  HOW GOOD IT IS FOR BROTHERS
lyrics:
Oh,  how good, how pleasant it is

For  brothers to live together in unity

Oh  how good is the blessing God gives

When  we worship Him together in unity

title: I  PLEDGE ALLEGIANCE
lyrics:
Chorus

I  pledge allegiance to the Lamb

With  all my strength, with all I am

I  will seek to honour His command

I  pledge allegiance to the Lamb.

I  have heard how Christians long ago

Were  brought before a tyrants throne

They  were told that he would spare their lives

If  they would renounce the name of Christ

But  one by one, they chose to die,

The  Son of God they would not deny.

Like  a great angelic choir sings,

I  can almost hear their voices ring

Now  the years have come and the years have gone

But  the cause of Jesus still goes on

Now  our time has come to count the cost

To  reject this world to embrace the cross

So,  one by one, let us live our lives

For  the One who died to give us life

‘Till  the trumpet sounds on that final day

Let  us proudly stand and boldly say….

To  the Lamb of God who bore my shame

Who  took my place and bore m pain

I  will seek to honour His command

I  pledge allegiance to the Lamb.

title: HE’S  MY LORD
lyrics:
He’s  my Lord, there is no other

Who  can calm the troubled sea

Like  my Lord

Giving  rest to the weary

Give  new life to the hopeless

There’s  no doubt about it,

He’s  my Lord.

title: HE’S  STILL WORKING ON ME
lyrics:
He’s  still working on me

To  make me what I ought to be

It  took Him just a week to make the moon and the  stars

The  sun and the earth, Jupiter and mars

How  loving and patient He must be

He’s  still working on me.

title: I  AM CRUCIFIED WITH CHRIST
lyrics:
I  am crucified with Christ,

Never  the less I live.

Yet  not I, but Christ liveth in me.

And  the life that I now live in flesh

I  live by the faith of the Son of God,

Who  loved me, and gave Himself for me.

title: I  CLAIM THE BLOOD
lyrics:
Chorus

I  claim the blood Jesus shed on Calvary

Those  precious blood stains

were  made there just for me

For  all my sins, my sickness and my pain

When  I need healing,

I  claim those precious blood stains

I  have a source of strength when I am weak

That  takes me through when life is pressing me

I  have a source of power from above

I’m  covered over by a shield of blood

I  do not know how others make it through

Who  never go to Calvary as I do

For  there’s a healing, cleansing stream which flows

With  peace that only His redeemed can know.

title: I  LOVE TO LOVE YOU
lyrics:
I  love to love You, Oh Lord my God

I  love to love You, Oh Lord my God

I  love to love  You, Oh Lord my God

When  I come to seek Your face,

I  find mercy and grace.

title: I  FEEL THE PULL
lyrics:
I  feel the pull, I hear the call

And  God’s spirits moving me

To  give my all.

He  speaks to me, and I agree.

Lord  please come and take control,

I  feel the pull.

title: I  WANT TO BE A LIVING BIBLE
lyrics:
Chorus

I  want to be a living Bible

I  want to walk it every day

For  I know that when I live the Bible

I’m  walking the straight and narrow way

There’s  many folks who don’t believe the Bible

I  want to tell them all right now I do

Cause  the Bible is the Word of God  that’s been sent

To  give us faith to rapture me and you.

I  tell you friend I’ve learned to love my Bible

It’s  been the thing that’s kept me all these years

And  I know that when I look into it’s pages

I’ll  never have a single thing to fear.

I  urge you all to go and read your Bible

It’s  the only thing that’s worthy of your time

And  as you pray to God for revelation

I  know that you will put on Jesus Christ.

title: WE  EXALT THEE
lyrics:
We  exalt Thee, we exalt Thee

We  exalt Thee, Oh Lord

We  exalt Thee, we exalt Thee

We  exalt Thee, Oh Lord

title: BOUNDLESS  LOVE
lyrics:
We  rejoice we rejoice in the name of the Lord

We  rejoice in His love today

By  His love we can conquer and do anything

We  rejoice in His love today

Boundless  love, boundless love

He  has conquered all of death and the grave

Boundless  love, boundless love

By  His love our souls are saved

title: SING  UNTO THE LORD A NEW SONG
lyrics:
Sing  unto the Lord a new song.

Sing  unto the Lord all the earth.

Oh  sing unto the Lord a new song,

For  He is worthy to be praised.

Come  before His presence with Thanksgiving

Enter  His courts with praise

Be  thankful unto Him and bless His Holy name

For  He is worthy to be praised

Lift  up holy hands and praise the Lord

Giving  thanks unto the Lord

He’s  worthy of all honour and praise

title: DRAW  ME CLOSER
lyrics:
Draw  me closer Lord,

Draw  me closer Lord,

So  that I might touch You

So  that I might touch You

Lord  I want to touch You.

Touch  my eyes, Lord,

Touch  my eyes, dear Lord,

So  that I might see You

So  that I might see You

Lord  I want to see You.

title: THE  SPIRIT SONG
lyrics:
Chorus

Jesus,  Oh Jesus, come and fill Your lambs

Jesus,  Oh Jesus, come and fill your lambs.

Oh  let the Son of God enfold you

With  His Spirit and His love

Let  Him fill your heart and satisfy your soul

Oh  let Him have the things that hold you

And  His Spirit like a dove

Will  descend upon your life and make you whole.

Oh  let His Word come now and mould you

As  you yield your heart to Him

Give  yourself in sweet surrender to His will

Oh  look each day for His appearing

Let  not your eyes of faith grow dim

For  He’s coming soon His promise to fulfill.

title: SURELY  THE PRESENCE OF THE LORD
lyrics:
Surely  the presence of the Lord is in this place

I  can feel His mighty power and grace

I  can hear the brush of angels wings

I  see glory on each face

Surely  the presence of the Lord is in this place.

title: SING  UNTO THE LORD A NEW SONG
lyrics:
F minor

Sing  unto the Lord a new song

Sing  unto the Lord of the earth

Sing  unto the Lord a new song

Sing  unto the Lord of the Earth

Sing  hallelujah …

title: OH  IT IS JESUS
lyrics:
Oh  it is Jesus, Yes it is Jesus

It  is Jesus in my soul

For  I have touched the hem of His garment

And  His blood has made me whole.

title: I  KEEP COMING BACK TO THE WELL
lyrics:
Blessed  is the fountain in a barren land

That  satisfies the thirst of the inner man

No  better place can be found to dwell

Oh,  won’t you come to the well

Chorus

I  keep coming back to the well of grace

Great  is the power, sweet is the taste

Whenever  temptations and trials I face

I  keep coming back to the well

Jesus  made a well at Calvary

For  healing, cleansing and victory

How  it’s joy overflows, no tongue can tell

I  thank God for the well.

title: YOU  ARE WORTHY OF THE PRAISE
lyrics:
I  lift my voice in praise to You

For  you are beautiful

I  lift my hands,  my heart, my soul

For  You are worthy of the praise

I  sing this song, to You Oh Lord

It’s  all I have to give

And  worship You, with all my might

You  are worthy of the praise

Lord  you, You are worthy of the praise

And  we, Lord we worship

Your  holy name

title: THE  BLOOD WILL NEVER LOSE ITS POWER
lyrics:
The  blood that Jesus shed for  me

Way  back on dark Calvary

The  blood that gives me strength

From  day to day, it will never lose it’s power

Chorus

For  it reaches to the highest mountain

And  it flows to the lowest valley

The  blood that gives me strength

from day to day

It  will never lose its power

It  soothes my doubts and it calms my fears

And  it dries, it dries every tear

The  blood that gives me strength

From  day to day, it will never lose it’s power.

title: I  WILL BLESS THE LORD AT ALL TIMES
lyrics:
I  will bless the Lord at all times

I  will bless the Lord at all times

His  praise shall continually be in my mouth

(Repeat  3X)

title: LORD  MOST HIGH
lyrics:
Lord  most high, Lord most high

You  are the King of Glory,

Forever  pure and holy

Lord,  most high.

Hallelujah,  hallelujah,

We  come before your throne

To  worship You alone

Lord,  most high.

title: I’VE  NEVER BEEN THIS HOMESICK
lyrics:
See  the bright lights shine,

It’s  just about home time

I  can see my Father standing at the door

This  world is but a wilderness

And  I’m ready for deliverance

Lord,  I’ve never been this home sick before.

title: WON’T  WE HAVE A TIME
lyrics:
Won’t  we have a time,

When  we get over yonder (Repeat 3X)

Oh,  won’t we have a time

We’ll  sing and shout and dance about …

King  Jesus will be there …

We’ll  have no sorrow there …

title: IT’S  KEEPING ME ALIVE
lyrics:
It’s  the Holy Ghost and fire

and it’s keeping me alive

Keeping  me alive, keeping me alive

It’s  the Holy Ghost and fire

and it’s keeping me alive

Jesus  is keeping me alive.

title: WERE  YOU THERE
lyrics:
Were  you there when they crucified my Lord

Were  you there when they crucified my Lord

Oh,  sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble

Were  you there when they crucified my Lord

Were  you there when they nailed Him

to the tree …

Were  you there when He rose up

from the grave …

title: THE  HILLS OF HOME
lyrics:
This  house of clay is but a prison

Bars  of bone, hold my soul

But  the doors of flesh

Are  gonna burst wide open

When  the hills of home start calling me

I’ll  take my flight like a mighty eagle

When  the hills of home start calling me.

title: KING  OF KINGS & LORD OF LORDS
lyrics:
F minor

King  of kings and Lord of lords

Glory,  hallelujah

King  of kings and Lord of lords

Glory,  hallelujah

Jesus,  prince of peace

Glory,  hallelujah

Jesus,  prince of peace

Glory,  hallelujah

title: OH  LORD, YOU’RE BEAUTIFUL
lyrics:
Oh  Lord, you’re beautiful

Your  face is all I seek

For  when Your eyes are on this child

Your  grace abounds in me.

I  want to take your word and shine it all around

But  first help me just believe it, Lord

And  when I’m doing well

Help  me to never seek a crown

For  my reward is giving glory to You.

Oh  lord, please light the fire

That  once burned bright and clear

Renew  the lamp of my first love

That  burned with Holy fear.

title: IN  THE BLOOD OF CHRIST MY LORD
lyrics:
In  the blood of Christ my Lord (3X)

We  have the victory

We  have the victory, we have the victory

In  the blood of Christ my Lord

We  have the victory.

title: WE  ARE MARCHING OVER TO JERUSALEM
lyrics:
We  are marching over to Jerusalem

We  are marching over to Jerusalem

Jerusalem,  Jerusalem

Jerusalem,  Jerusalem

title: IF  I PERISH
lyrics:
If  I perish, I perish but I’m going to see the King

If  I perish, I perish but I’m going to see the King

Through  dark trials, tribulation, persecution,

I’ll be faithful

But  I’m going  home to see the King

(Repeat)

If  my father won’t go

Mother  won’t go,

Brother  won’t go, Sister won’t go

I’m  going to see the King

(Repeat)

title: BURN,  BURN, HOLY SPIRIT
lyrics:
Burn,  burn, Holy Spirit, burn in me

Set  my soul on fire

Fill  me with the Holy Ghost and God’s full desire

Make  me like the Christ of old

Healing  and raising the dead

Give  me the power that Jesus had

Through  the blood that was shed.

title: WE’RE  GOING DOWN THE VALLEY
lyrics:
We’re  going down the valley, Up the mountain

Jerusalem  is my home

We’re  going down the valley, Up the mountain

Jerusalem  is my home

It’s  my home, sweet home,

Jerusalem  is my home.

It’s  my home, sweet home,

Jerusalem  is my home.

title: AS  WE GATHER
lyrics:
As  we gather may your spirit work within us

As  we gather may we glorify your name

Knowing  that as our hearts begin to worship

We’ll  be blessed because we came  (2X)

The  steadfast love of the Lord never ceases

His  mercies never come to an end

They  are new every morning new every morning

Great  is thy faithfulness, Oh Lord

Great  is Thy faithfulness.

title: COME  AND FILL US  NOW
lyrics:
We  have come into your presence Lord

Come  and fill us now

We  have come into your presence Lord

Come  and fill us now

With  hands lifted up

We  open up our hearts to you Lord

And  with our hearts lifted up

We  glorify Your name

We  have come into your presence Lord

Come  and fill us now

title: BY  HIS GRACE I AM REDEEMED
lyrics:
By  His grace I am redeemed.

By  His Blood I am made clean,

And  I now can know Him face to face.

By  His power I have been raised,

hidden  now in Christ by faith.

I  will praise the glory of His grace.

title: LORD  I WORSHIP YOU ALONE
lyrics:
All  heaven declares the Glory of the risen Lord

Who  can compare with the beauty of the Lord

Forever  He will be the Lamb upon the Throne

And  I’ll gladly bend my knee,

To  worship You alone.

I  will proclaim the Glory of the risen Lamb,

Who  once was slain to reconcile man to God.

Forever  You will be the Lamb upon the throne

And  I’ll gladly bend my knee,

To  worship You alone.

title: BLESSED  BE THE LORD GOD ALMIGHTY
lyrics:
Father  in heaven we love You.

We  lift Your name  in all the earth.

May  your kingdom be established in our praises.

As  your people declare your mighty word.

Blessed  be the Lord God Almighty,

Who  was, and is, and is to come.

Blessed  be the Lord God almighty,

Who  lives forevermore.

title: LORD  I WANT TO LOVE YOU MORE
lyrics:
Lord  I want to love You more

Than  I ever have before.

You’re  so easy to adore

Lord,  I want to love You more.

title: FOREVER YOU WILL BE
lyrics: All heaven declares the glory of the risen Lord, Who can compare with the beauty of the Lord?  CHORUS  Forever You will be, The Lamb who died for me, And I’ll gladly bend my knees, To worship You alone.  I will proclaim the glory of the risen Lamb Who once was slain to reconcile man to God.

title: THE HEAVENS DO RULE
lyrics: Oh, the depth of the knowledge  And the wisdom of the Lord! His judgements are unsearchable, And His ways past finding out; Who hath directed His Spirit? And whose counsel did He take? For by Him and through Him Are all things on earth made.  CHORUS  And we know that all things work together for our good, The footsteps of the righteous are ordered by the Lord; Even though things don’t work out The way we think they should, Yet we know in all things, That the heavens surely rule.  Which of us by taking thought could add to ourselves? Why do we yet so many times resist His will? We’ve got to realize salvation is wholly of the Lord; Just stand still and consider All the wondrous works of God.  There is nothing that happens without a real intent, Our experiences were ordained,  Our trials have been sent That we might manifest the purpose Unto which we have been called, So in perfect confidence We can submit to Him our all.

title: THANK YOU FOR THE RAIN
lyrics: For twenty-three years we have been looking For God to send the revival amongst us; Wednesday the 3rd of June we received our inheritance claim; Now we know the New Name And we are not hollering again, and again, and again And again.  CHORUS  Thank You Lord for sending    }        the rain, (Hallelujah)                 }2x We thank you again and again,  And again and again and again, We thank You.  All false branches must be cut off, For the tree must be pruned and cleaned, For it’s the Holy Spirit that is planting the life within us Because He knows that we are the Bride, are the Bride, are the Bride, are the Bride.  Many families, they were attached to this Word But they were under man’s    teaching; When our shepherd waved the wave-sheaf over them, Then they realized they are not shuck, but they are seed, they are seed, they are seed, they are seed.

title: I LOVE HIM
lyrics: I love Him, I love Him, Because He first loved me, And purchased my salvation on Calvary’s tree.

title: TURN ON THE LIGHT
lyrics: A people that once sat in darkness saw a marvelous light, The light of God’s revealed Word flashed across our hearts And we have been made whole. Now we walk in the light as He is in the light, Having fellowship one with the    other, God’s blood that cleanses and His love that conquers.  CHORUS  There’s a man here that can turn on the light,  There’s a man here that can turn on the light,  So If you’re in darkness, cannot find your way, There’s a man here that can show you the way.  In the beginning was the Word and the Word was with God, And the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us, The light of God’s revealed Word Face to face we see now, Almighty God unveiled before us, The Lamb that was slain, who took the Book And showed us our names.  King Theophany Jesus that is walking in and amongst us, God En Morphe for the final turn at the west. So when you look, what do you see now? It depends on what you’re looking for, We are a people that have been set free, Living epistles that can show you the door.

title: PAST THE CURTAIN OF TIME
lyrics: There’s a curtain that’s drawn between earth and Heaven, And just beyond lies a beautiful   clime Where the evils of this life no longer can touch me; Lord, let me look past the curtain of time.  CHORUS  Lord, let me look past the curtain of sorrows and fear, Let me view that sunny bright clime; It would strengthen my faith and would banish all fear; Lord, let me look past the curtain of time.  I’m helpless, alone, and I want to see Jesus, And hear the sweet harbor bells chime, Where my friends and dear loved ones are waiting for me; Lord, let me look past the curtain of time.  I’m so homesick and blue, and I want to see Jesus, I would like to hear those sweet harbor bells chime; It would brighten my path and would vanish my fear; Lord, let me look past the curtain of time.

title: A GIFT OF GRACE
lyrics: A Gift of Grace was all it took To redeem me again back to His own; I’ve been redeemed, He saved my soul, My Saviour paid the price, Now I’m no more my own.  CHORUS  So seek on Saints, Seek till you’re filled with  power; Seek on saints Till His Spirit in you is  endowed, It’s been revealed, This is the final hour; And soon His Bride, His Chosen One Will go on home.  Unmerited the favour that He granted me To bring me home today, His very Own; ’Twas love, ’twas Grace That stooped so low to conquer  me; My Sovereign Lord gave  Sovereign Grace To redeem me.  And now I’m home, His robe’s wrapped around me; This land is mine, this Promise is  for me. Amazing grace, amazing love Christ poured on me, His Word went with a promise, One day we shall meet.

title: I WILL PRAISE THE LORD
lyrics: I will praise the Lord, I will praise the Lord, No matter what tomorrow brings, What it has in store, I will praise the Lord.

title: PRAISE YE THE LORD
lyrics:
Praise ye the Lord all ye people! Praise Him for His goodness,        His majesty and power; For His merciful kindness is great towards us, And His righteousness endureth forever.  CHORUS  He’s the Lord of creation, He’s the Rock of our salvation, He paid the price for our    redemption, And He is worthy, (so worthy) He is our comfort in times of     sorrow, Our strength to face tomorrow, Our refuge in times of trouble, And He alone is worthy to be   praised.  Give thanks unto Him and serve Him, For He forgiveth all thy sins, And healeth all thy diseases, Who redeemeth you from a life of destruction, And crowneth you with loving kindness and tender mercies.  BRIDGE  We have so much to praise and thank Him for, Our lives are testimonies  And so many  great things He has done. Forget not His love and His   promises, For He has promised a new Heaven,  A new Earth and a new Body. Praise Him, praise Him, For He alone is worthy to be praised, Praise Him, praise Him, For He alone is worthy to be praised,
So all you got to do is praise Him, praise Him. For He alone is worthy to be praised, Praise Him, praise Him. For He alone is worthy to be praised, For He alone is worthy to be praised.

title: PEACE! PEACE!
lyrics: Peace! peace! wonderful peace, Coming down from the Father   above; Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray, In the fathomless billows of love.

title: PARENTAL CARE
lyrics: You loved me when I was so unlovable You died for me when I wasn’t worth dying for You taught me real Godliness; is with contentment And that my trials only come to bring me patience  Truly your ways is not like our ways  And your thoughts like our thoughts Yet you chip and you mold me to  Bring me into your image  CHORUS  Truly your love is not parental care for a baby  But your love truly is elective love  You may cause me to suffer like Job  Or to be delivered unto to death like Paul  But yet in the midst of the all you’re just  Proving how much you really, really, really Love me  You taught me when I’m weak, that I’m strong And the only way up is down In order to live in your presence, I must die Your love is simply amazing who could deny   BRIDGE  Whosoever the Lord loveth, He chasteneth  And if we are without chastisement  We are not of His.  Now no chastisement for the present   Seemeth joyous but then it brings forth  the peaceable fruits of righteousness

title: WE ARE STANDING
lyrics: When I walked through the door I felt His presence And I know this is the place Where love abounds; And this is the temple, Jehovah God  abides, And we are standing in His presence On Holy ground.  CHORUS  We are standing on holy ground And I know that there are Angels all around; Let us praise Jesus now, For we are standing in His presence On Holy ground.  In His presence,  There is joy beyond all measure; At His feet, peace of mind can still be found, So if you have a need,                         I know He has the answer, So reach out and touch Him, For we are standing on holy ground.

title: THIS IS HOLY GROUND
lyrics: This is holy ground,                  } We’re standing on holy round,} For the Lord is here;                        } And where He is, is holy.           }2x  These are holy hands,                We’re lifting up holy hands,        For the Lord is here                      And where He is, is holy.            These are holy hands,          We’re lifting up holy hands,        For the Lord is here           And where He is, is holy.

title: ARISE AND POSSESS
lyrics: CHORUS  Arise, possess your inheritance, For this is the year of jubilee, Arise, be not entangled with the yoke of bondage. Understand the liberty by which Christ set you free.  Entangled with heavy chains of captivity, Bruised and battered by sin, Condemned and sentenced to a life of bondage, O God, there was no peace within. Then a sound was heard, It was like the abundance of rain, Saying “Rejoice, you have received the atonement, Accept the pardoning word which was provided for you, Because you’re not of the bondwoman, You’re of the free.”  Aren’t you tired of living underprivileged? Saints, don’t you, don’t you hear that sound? Saying freedom to the captives, Restoration to the blind, Setting free those who are bruised. Saints, empty your vessels, Let Him fill them with oil, You are free, you are free, you are free. So when the creditor comes to take away your land, Show him your account Settled long ago by Calvary’s Lamb, And say, “I am free, I am free, I am free.”   Now I can tell the world that I’m free, I have heard the trumpet sound Jubilee; Freedom from all burdens and sin, The Comforter has given me peace within. ///And whom the Son has set free, is free indeed.///

title: GOING HOME
lyrics: CHORUS  I’m going home in the morning, I’m going home, it won’t be long, I’m going home, it won’t be long.  Can’t afford to get my line tangled in these kind of times, So I’m looking nine times before I make one step, Don’t want to be caught In an unconscious state of mind, For I want to leave this earth In the twinkling of an eye.  I’m going to slip from time into eternity, I’m going to become one with my Theophany, Going to live in that mansion God has prepared for me, I’m going to leave this pest-house for eternity.  We’re going to be reunited with  our loved ones Who have gone on before to another dimension; Soon we’ll see Him face to face, The One who lives inside our hearts; Who saved us by His amazing grace, We’ll be with Him never to depart.  Could it be between six or nine? Whatever the time I want to be ready to meet my Bridegroom.

title: THIS  THE YEAR OF JUBILEE
lyrics: This is the year of Jubilee, This is the year of Jubilee, When all the captives are set free Come ye halt, ye blind, ye lame, Leap and shout for joy again, This is the year of Jubilee.......

title: I’LL FLY AWAY
lyrics: Some glad morning when this life is over,  I’ll fly away, To  a home on God’s celestial shore I’ll fly away.  CHORUS  I’ll fly away, O, glory! I’ll fly away When I die, hallelujah! by and by, I’ll fly away.  When the shadows of this life have grown, I’ll fly away; Like a bird from prison bars has flown, I’ll fly away.  Just a few more weary days and then, I’ll fly away; To a land where joys shall never end, I’ll fly away.

title: PART OF HIS BRIDE
lyrics: He leads me through troubled waters, He holds my hands through darkest sky; He comforts me when my heart is laden down with grief, He’s coming back to take me away as His bride.  CHORUS  For I’m His bride, I’m His only loved one, I’m His chosen, His fair one, His dove; For I was predestined,                       In His grace, I now abide. What an honour, oh, how marvelous, what a privilege, Thank You Jesus, I’m part of Your bride.  Before the world, He knew me in glory, Before the sun, I lived and reigned with Him; Now my soul longs to see Him, On the clouds that He rides, Coming back to rapture me as His bride.

title: HOLY SPIRIT
lyrics: Holy Spirit, Thou art welcome in this place, Holy Spirit, Thou art welcome in this place,  Omnipotent Father of mercy and Grace Thou art welcome in this place.

title: WE ARE LIKE SHIPS
lyrics: CHORUS  We are like ships sailing across life's troubled sea,                           But with our compass set on the North Star                                  We'll reach the shores of Eternity,   We are like ships sailing across life's troubled sea,                           But with our compass set on the North Star                                  We'll reach the shores of Eternity.  Contrary winds of doctrine blew against us on the way, But we set our eye on the Captain, Listened to what He had to say. Many ships were tossed to and fro ad were driven off their course, But we are thankful to our Captain, We aren't shipwrecked, we aren't lost. He said, “Peace be still.”          } To see the glory of the Lord you}  must stand still.                        } 2x  We are sailing through many rough waters, Using our paddles skillfully, Now we are faced with treacherous conditions, We need the Master of the sea To say "Peace be still." To see your troubles end, you must stand still; He’ll say, “Peace be still.” To see the glory of the Lord you must stand still.  Upon the distant shore, there’s a land that’s shining bright; Soon we'll reach that golden shore And be welcomed by the Prince of Light. He'll say, “Peace be still, My light has led you to do My perfect will.” He'll say, “Peace be still," And when we see Him face to face  We must stand still.

title: THE BRIDGE TO HEAVEN
lyrics: Left the splendour of His throne, Came down to earth, Had one purpose in His mind. Tempted in all points as we are Yet without sin, Most worthy High Priest, He's the Supreme Sacrifice.  CHORUS  He is the bridge from Earth to} Heaven,                                    } 2x We now live in God's presence forever.  I'll always look to Calvary where Redemption price was paid for me, There on the cross, crucified with Him. There on the cross I was in Him, There on the cross I paid for my sin, And His glory, I now boldly enter in.  Lift your eyes to Calvary, see where He has set you free, Loosed from the grips of sin and shame. Sin has no more dominion over you, You’re ordained to do just what you do, He’s that bridge to Heaven for me and you.  To the splendour of His throne, His Bride now leaves the Earth, Quickening power now breaks the hold of time; Travelling faster than the speed of light, We'll be changed in the twinkling of an eye, And that bridge to Heaven will be no more.

title: I'M GLAD HE SET ME FREE
lyrics: I’m so glad Jesus set me free,}3x Glory, hallelujah, Jesus set me free. (I’m so glad Jesus lifted me...) (I’m on my way to Heaven, shouting victory...)

title: ALLELUJAH
lyrics: We are the children of God, Chosen vessels unto Him; Our angels behold the Father’s  face We are special unto Him. We should never be ashamed To testify of our love for Him, For we are privileged To be the children of the KING  of KINGS!  CHORUS  Al-le-lu-jah!                                     } Glory and praise to the               } Saviour;                                        } Al-le-lu-jah!                                 } Let’s worship our King                 } together.                                      }2x  We must dwell in unity So we’re showing our love to Him, Having a blameless testimony A life that’s holy and free from  sin; We should be an example To the lost who know not the  way: We’re not children of the night  but of the day, So let us show them the way.  With the joy of the Lord And the strength of our youth, Let’s be zealous to do God’s  will; Fleeing youthful lusts and  pressing to be Empty vessels that God can fill. We should never lean to our own understanding, Casting our reasoning down, So we’ll be better able to love  and serve Him.

title: THIRST
lyrics: As we set our faces towards Jerusalem, Knowing that very soon the squeeze will come, As the day draws nearer, as the day draws closer, There’s such a painful desire to be like our Saviour.  CHORUS  Oh Jesus, my Lord Jesus, } Only You, only You              } Can quench this thirst          } in my soul.                          } 2x  Many nights I can’t sleep, everyday my soul groans in me, Waiting for the redemption of this body; No matter what the world may say,  No matter what the world may do, It’s a fact that I can’t rest until I’m perfect.  Before the Masterpiece could speak it must be smitten By the determinate counsel of our God, What shall I say then, ‘Father take this cup from me?’ But nevertheless not my will but Thine be done.  Signs of the time quickly approaching, We can see the whole creation is groaning; But, for this purpose came we into this world; To fulfill what is written of us.

title: MORE THAN EVER BEFORE
lyrics: More than ever before, Lord, I love You, More than ever before, Lord, I need You, More than ever before, I want to serve You; I love You now,                              More than ever before.

title: WHAT WILL YOU PRESENT?
lyrics: I want to present the life of  Christ, It’s my aim today, For in His image I want to stand So blameless on that day; And though this world may  criticize, It will never understand, That I can’t rest until I be A perfect man.  CHORUS  What are you going to present to  the Lord At the end of your journey? He’s not going to be touched by anything Save His testimony. What are you going to present to  the Lord? I hope it makes you sigh and cry, Don’t be found in that position Where you would be wondering why.  Though the world may offer its pleasure and peace, And its luxurious life of ease, But it simply cannot continue on For man’s just like a breeze; A moment here and a moment gone, Like a flower he fades away, But I just want to stay right on To that perfect day.  Take rest my soul, in no other arms Save Jesus own today For He has opened my eyes to see That judgement is on its way; And though ten thousand fall at my side I will never be tossed aside; For in the shadow of that mighty rock is where I’ll abide.  Lord take Thy Word, Thy  precious Word, And anoint it to my soul; Perfect what is lacking in  my faith And make thy servant whole.   For I just want to hear You say, “Receive thy crown my beloved  son You have overcome, well done!”

title: JESUS WILL TAKE CARE
lyrics: Have you ever been so distressed When you see your circumstances look so gloomy, And the tears begin to cover your eyes? Remember Jesus will take care of you.  CHORUS  He’s the Rock of all the ages, He’s the light in the darkest night, A comfort when there’s no one left to care; So you don’t look at your circumstances, They will only bring you down, Remember Jesus will take care of you.  When you feel so weak and can’t go on; And the devil, he tempts you so sore; But if you only call upon Jesus,  He will answer, For He knows that you’re weak on your own.

title: MANY WATERS
lyrics: There are so many people in the world today Don’t really know what  true love is; Many have searched the  whole wide world And still can’t seem  to find it. Love is patient, love is kind, True love can never be broken; Love beareth all things,  Love suffers long. Love is God and God is love, Who is our King; But how can you know true love Without knowing Him?  CHORUS  Many waters cannot        } quench love,                     } Neither can the floods     } drown it,                              }3x Whosoever God joins      together,           Let no man put asunder.  Therefore shall a man leave father and mother And cleave unto his wife, Then they shall be no more twain  But they shall be one. Then he’ll love his bride as Christ the church, Who giveth Himself for it; For no man yet hateth his flesh, But loveth and cherisheth it. Love is God and God is love, Who is our King; So how can you know true love Without knowing Him?

title: WE ARE CHILDREN
lyrics: We are children of the Father, We are joint-heirs with the Son, We are people of His Kingdom, We are family, we are one.

title: RUN WITH THE MESSAGE
lyrics: There are people all over the  world, To whom this Message must be told; All those honest in heart, In this light they have a part.  CHORUS  You’ve got to run, run, run, run, Run with the Message of  Malachi 4, You’ve got to tell it like you’ve  never told it before; Let him that readeth run, Let him that heareth run, For this Message is the coming of the Lord.  Always ready to give a  reason, Be instant in and out of season, Willing to take this blessed  hope To a lost and dying world.  Seeing we have this ministry, Let’s not faint but earnestly Seek to build the kingdom of God, For the glory of the Lord.

title: HEAVEN  IS SWEETER
lyrics: Heaven's sounding sweeter all the time, Seems like lately I can’t get it off my mind, Someday I’m going to leave this world behind. Heaven's sounding sweeter all the time.

title: HIS WORD IS WORKING
lyrics: His Word is working mightily in me His Word is working mightily in me No matter what the circumstance; Nor how I feel or see His Word is working mightily in me.

title: CHRIST’S WARRIORS
lyrics: The King desires a drink of water, ..............(Christ’s Mighty    Gentile Warriors) Between His rejection and His  Power, ..............(Christ’s Mighty Gentile  Warriors), Noble Mighty men of valour, ..............(Christ’s Mighty    Gentile Warriors) Are cutting through to get a drink  of water.  CHORUS  Mighty Gentile Warriors } of the end-time,               }2x Valiant Mighty Gentiles of the  end-time Bringing a clean fresh drink for the King.  Our foes are filled with fear and trembling, ..............(Christ’s Mighty    Gentile Warriors) As the Super-Church comes  marching, ..............(Christ’s Mighty    Gentile Warriors,) They have heard how we  overcame ..............(Christ’s Mighty    Gentile Warriors) Theologians and false anointed ones.  The Bride of Christ is marching over, ..............(Christ’s Mighty    Gentile Warriors) To the New Jerusalem, ..............(Christ’s Mighty    Gentile Warriors) Led by King Theophany ..............(Christ’s Mighty    Gentile Warriors) To dwell with Him in His Holy City.

title: BE STRONG IN THE LORD
lyrics: CHORUS Be strong in the Lord,  Be empowered, Through your union with Him Draw all your strength, Put on the armour that God supplies, That you, you may be able to stand.  We’re not wrestling with flesh and blood, Contending with physical things, But we’re standing in faith, Against the rulers of this world; Empowered by His spirit, In the authority of His name.  Having shod your feet With the Good News of peace, Girding your loins with His truth, The breastplate of righteousness And the helmet of salvation; The shield of faith and the sword of the Spirit.  Now standing complete in His image, Refusing to be shaken from your place, Praying at all times in the Spirit of the Lord, Interceding on behalf of all the saints.

title: WE’VE COME THIS
lyrics: We’ve come this far by faith, Leaning on the Lord. Trusting in His holy Word; For now we have a perfect  faith  Oh, Oh, Oh, We can’t turn back, We’ve come this far by faith.  Just remember the good things He has done, Things that seemed so impossible, We praise Him for the victories we have won!

title: ONE LOVE
lyrics:
CHORUS   One love, one love, one love, one love.  There was a time in the history of man When he commanded the creation And he and his Maker had one love; And then the deceiver came, And man lost the power of the Name, For he had broken the bond of one love; It then took the blood of a spotless lamb To be an atonement for fallen man It was God’s substitute for his sin and shame ; It was a part of God’s great mystery To redeem you and me again, Back to ................} chorus  Then one day the real Lamb came, He came in the Father’s Name To be a ransom for one love. When on the cross my Saviour     died, The power of death He had defied, To give us the token of one love. He then changed our destiny, He could now come and live in you and me, Making us creatures now bound for eternity; Brothers and sisters can’t you see, He died to set you and I free again! Back to .............} chorus  The Holy Ghost the Lord did send, He fell upon some redeemed men, They had the token and one love. They baptized in Jesus Name; And of His doctrine they weren’t ashamed, For they were believers in one love. But then as the ages rolled away
From this doctrine evil men did    stray; And the serpent began to ride this trail again. Beware of the creeds of wicked men, Designed to bring us back to bondage again; But we want .......} chorus  In the end time the Son of man came, He came in His Father’s Name To give us the token of one love. Seven Thunders sounded in our souls, Our Lord had gathered us from this wicked world To be united in one love; Then we will speak and command creation again, Sons and daughters in the Father’s Name, Having power and wrapped up in His love; The trumpet shall sound And we’ll take our flight to the skies To be in glory where we’ll be with our Father again, Back to ..........}chorus

title: WE’LL WALK IN THE LIGHT
lyrics: We’ll walk in the Light, We’ll walk in the Light, We’ll walk in the Light, Walk, in the  Light of God. Walk, walk, walk, in the Light, Walk, walk, walk, in the Light, Walk, walk, walk, in the Light,                          Walk in the Light of God.  Famba Esibonakaleni,               Famba Esibonakaleni, Famba Esibonakaleni, Esibonakaleni kwe sikwembo, Famba, famba, famba, famba, Famba, famba, famba, famba, Famba, famba, famba, famba, Esibonakaleni kwe sikwembo.

title: BE IDENTIFIED
lyrics:
What does it profit a man to follow  The vain traditions of misguided men, Who try to establish a righteousness of their own; A propitiation for their sins?  BRIDGE  O tell me, What do you think of the blood of Jesus That was shed for you? Is it sufficient to pardon you from sin (Is it sufficient to purge your conscience from sin,) (Is it sufficient to give you dominion over sin,) Set you free, putting peace within?  CHORUS  Just be identified with your sacrifice To be really justified, look to the place where Jesus died; Be identified, really justified,  Look to the place where Jesus died.  What can a man do to be justified? What does it take for an angry God to be pacified? If you trust in your power, or struggle with all your might, Yet your righteousness is like filthy rags in God’s sight.  What a work of grace that a man could clearly see The Lamb with seven horns and seven eyes, When darkness covers the earth and death begins to strike In the place where the blood has not been applied!  BRIDGE  What do you think of the opening of those Seals, God’s provided way for you?
Is it sufficient?  Then, don’t add or take away; It’s God's provided way to save you in this day. What a work of power the blood has done for you and me, Lifting us from a life of sin, turning our bodies heavenly. And when Satan tries to convict you in the courts of memory, Hear the Lamb return the verdict: “Not guilty, not guilty!”  (“Not guilty, you are free!”)

title: BEULAH LAND
lyrics: I’m kind of homesick for a country To which I’ve never been before; No sad good-byes would there be spoken, And time wouldn’t matter any more.  CHORUS  Beulah Land, I’m longing for you! And someday on thee I’ll stand, There my home shall be eternal, Beulah Land, sweet Beulah Land.  I’m looking now across that river To where pain is going to end    inside, Now just a few more days to labour; Then I shall take my heavenly flight.

title: Proverbs 3:9 HONOUR THE LORD
lyrics: Honour the Lord With all thy substance, And the first fruits of all thine  increase; So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, And thy presses shall burst out with new wine.  When you bring it                         } In the House of the Lord,          }     Bring it, in the House of the Lord,     } And I will pour out my blessings        } upon you.                                              }2x

title: COME WHAT MAY
lyrics:
He didn’t say that it was going to be easy; Every promise my Lord has made We’ve got to fight to claim. For as many as He called,  He gave the power to overcome; And every devil that stands before us Must be on the run! So why should I ever think it     strange When fiery trials should come my way? For He said that if I do suffer for His Name, With Him I shall reign.  CHORUS  Come what may, with Your Word I will stay, Come what may, I’ll press through anyway; Come what may, Lord have Your  way.  I’ll consider Him  Who for the joy that was set before Him, The cross He endured; And that same life now dwelleth within me Victory I’m assured. For He did say, He’ll never leave me nor forsake me, And as a seed of Abraham I’ll possess the gates of my    enemies! Why should I ever think it  strange When fiery trials should come  my way? For He said that if I do suffer for His Name With Him I shall reign.  As I journey along, May Lord I ever be, courageous and strong; For inch by inch I’ll possess the land
For I’m a journeyman, By striving lawfully, Knowing Thou savourest  reverence and humility; Let the fullness of that meal  offering Be displayed in me! I should never ever think it  strange When fiery trials should come  my way, For You said that if I do suffer  for Your Name, With You I shall reign.  When I am down on the ground, May I press through like a lily In spite of the muck all around; Rejoicing in the glory wherein You have clothed me. When I am up in the air And the strong winds blow, May I ever know that You are there; But if I be like a wounded dove, May I press through with Your message of Love. For I no longer ever think it strange When fiery trials should come  my way; For I know that if I do suffer for Your Name Lord, with You I shall reign.

title: IT'S JUBILEE TIME  AGAIN
lyrics: It's Jubilee time again, The outpouring of the Latter rain, When you hear the Trumpet, Shout and worship Him.  Keep on rejoicing, rejoicing, It's Jubilee time again, Rejoicing, rejoicing, The anointing breaks every chain  Keep on rejoicing, rejoicing. You are pardoned from your sin, Rejoicing, rejoicing, The anointing breaks every chain

title: LET THE RAIN COME DOWN
lyrics:
We are living in these last days, In a harassing and a thirsty age. God sent Elijah His prophet again That He might come and bring the rain.  CHORUS  Let the rain come down, Let the thunder roll, Filling me up, let me overflow Till I can take no more; Filling me up, let me overflow Till I can take no more.  When you are a seed of God, You’ve got to be planted in the Word to die; Your body might decay here in the earth, But it will spring to life with  eternal growth.  In these last days we are living in, We know that the life which is in us will spring again, As small as a mustard seed, saints, it will grow; As big and wide with branches flowing on the other side!  I want the former and the latter rain to reign in you; I want the former and the latter rain to reign in me; I want the former and the latter rain to reign in you; I want the former and the latter rain to reign in me.  I want the rain to come and give me Faith, I want the rain to come and give me Virtue, Let the rain come and give me Knowledge, I want the rain to give me Temperance, Let the rain come and give me Patience,
I want the rain to give me     Godliness, Let the rain come and give me Brotherly Kindness, And Charity that the Super-anointing power could be seen in me.  Let the rain come down. (Repeat four times)

title: GOD IN SIMPLICITY
lyrics: It’s God in simplicity, Now revealed in humility, King of Kings and Lord of Lords; His name is called the Word of     God, It’s God in simplicity.  The Seven Thunder mystery, How He formed Himself in me; Now I know I’m part of Him; Soon He’ll come and take me home, It’s God in simplicity.  Christ is the mystery, Now revealed in you and me, King of Kings and Lord of Lords; His name is called the Word of     God; Christ is the mystery.

title: JESUS  YOUR NAME
lyrics: Jesus Your name is Power. Jesus Your name is Might. Jesus Your name will break every stronghold, Jesus Your name is Life.  Jesus Your name is Healing. Jesus Your name gives Sight. Jesus Your name will free every captive, Jesus Your name is Life.  Jesus Your name is Holy. Jesus Your name is Light. Jesus Your name is above every other, Jesus Your name is Life.

title: SHE STEPS A LADY
lyrics: She steps a lady all clothed in  white, Surrounded by a rainbow-colored light; The sweetest smile she wears across her face, As she beholds the One in whom she has found grace.  CHORUS  And what joy now fills her  lover’s heart! As He beholds His lovely Bride at last; And with joy will the angels sing, What adoration from the Seraphim!  Objections considered, all  hollering will cease, All other women will have to hold their peace; He whispered to us in a language unknown, And now the beauty of His Bride will be shown.  Oh, the mystery that the two have now become one, And the victory of all ages is finally won; Flesh of His flesh, bone of His  bone, we are the same, United we stand under that special name.  The Lamb takes His wife by the hand And leads her unto the promised land, Humble woman, He has chosen for His own, Will sit with Him as Queen upon His Throne.

title: GIVE ME MY MOUNTAIN
lyrics: Give me my mountain, Amen, Give me my mountain, Amen, Give me my mountain; The prophet had promised Give me my mountain, Amen.

title: HIS MISSING RIB
lyrics: It was some thousand years ago In the beautiful garden of Eden; When God made man and placed him  Over the earth to have dominion, But He saw man was alone, He had no one to share his home.  So God put man into a sleep And took from his side, One of his ribs close to his heart With which He formed his bride. His missing rib has been restored, His missing rib was in bride form.  This bride has come all dressed in white, A veil she has put on. She’s come to stand at the side of him Whom she was taken from. His missing rib has been restored, His missing rib is in bride form.

title: WE ARE  GOING OUT
lyrics: A prophet like unto Moses came  to us in this day, Vindicated with signs and  wonders, He came to show us the way; But now he’s left us, gone on to glory, And God has Joshua on the  scene; So be thou strong and of good courage, As He was with Moses,                    So He’ll  be with thee.  CHORUS  For we are the children going Out of Egypt’s land, We are the children marching  Into the promised land; We are the children crossing over. The Ark is going before us, We are the children going out In this Third Exodus.  Oh children, let’s all be ready, Heed to all that God commands; Let us obey all His instructions To enter into the promised land He is the captain of our salvation, Defeated all our enemies. Do not be fearful, just be courageous; He is the leader as we march to victory.

title: THE ANCIENT OF DAYS
lyrics:
I beheld in the courts of Heaven Where great treason was opposed: Michael fought the great red Dragon Who wanted to take control. Kicked out of Heaven with the third of the stars, Like lightning they fell to the earth, They mingled the seed of men, And by deceit, they gained control, Until...  CHORUS  The Ancient of days did come, With experience, maturity and wisdom; The Ancient of days did come, Restoring full dominion. The Ancient of  days did come With experience, maturity and  wisdom , The Ancient of days did come And we must overcome.  MONOLOGUE  I beheld this same dragon on the earth was a dreadful beast: He plundered and devoured, having kings to bow at his feet. But, I beheld till the Prince of Princes came, Great Michael, en morphe As the bloody Lamb that was slain, He brought to us the victory. He is....  I beheld this beast was wounded But his deadly wound was healed: He cast down the truth, exalted a lie, Having the whole world to be deceived. I beheld till a Mighty Angel came With an open book in His hand, He gave me skill and wisdom to understand God’s great mystery plan.  MONOLOGUE
I stood in the ranks of a great army, They were the saints of the most high God; We fought the dragon and overcame By Michael’s two-edged sword.

title: TIRED UNDERPRIVILEGED
lyrics:
When I think about what God has done Back there on Calvary; Even Seven Angels coming in a Cloud Bringing back redemption for me Opening up the Lamb’s book of Life And all the hidden mysteries, And I know that we have eaten the Book, What a people we should be! And when I see another corn of wheat Coming to a mature stage, And this is the day of redemption And the price has been paid; Yet I see the things You’ve promised Missing in my life, Oh how I want to lose my life, So your Life could be    } wrapped up in mine.       } 2x  CHORUS  For I’m tired living  underprivileged When I see what God has done; I’m tired living as a servant When it’s time for manifested  sons. Lord, You gave revival and And you promised the Third Pull too; For the greater works we          } have to do.                               }2x  There are souls under the altar, They are crying out 'how long     Lord?' Sleeping saints, they are anxiously Awaiting on the resurrection. In my heart there is a cry To go back to that place, No more darkly in a mirror But seeing face to face. The whole creation is groaning, Waiting on that sweet release;
The lion wants to lay down with the lamb For a thousand years of peace; And I want to see the One Who has been with us all the  time; But still I want to lose my life So His Life could be wrapped    } up in mine.                                 } 2x  A new day has dawned And I just can’t go on this way, Just saying that I’m a Christian, Walking with my Bible everyday, The Prophet said the true church would write Another Book of Acts, And if I don’t come back to that place Then I have missed the mark. But between revivals the locks have grown, There is a possibility; The meal has been placed upon the sticks To be baked into reality, Faith to use the power Is growing greater all the time. So like Samson: Just once more Lord, Like Esther: If I perish I perish  Lord, Like Jonah: to do Your bidding Lord, Like Joseph: to be a prisoner; For the greater works we   } have to do.                          } 2x

title: WE ARE  GOING OVER
lyrics: We are going over Jordan.}3x  And the ark is going before us.}3x  And the waters now are parting.}3x

title: SHE IS MY BRIDE
lyrics:
Come, see what I’ve found In the dust of the ground; A pearl of great price, A jewel for my crown. The gentle look in her eyes, Motherhood she won’t despise, Such a jewel is rare to find. She’s like an Easter flower That the Rock of ages did shelter; Her beauty, her character is undefiled.  CHORUS  And she is my bride, She is my virtuous wife; She is my bride Today and forever.  I’ve suffered much pain Before I could take my claim, But she was chosen long ago to bear my name. We shared years of intimacy, She was the great mystery in me; She is flesh of my flesh And bone of my bone.  MONOLOGUE  I believe, “blessed is the man who can find a virtuous wife,” for we live in a time when the daughters of men are fair.  But what is beauty without  character anyway?...  Just vanity..... So sons of God, turn your eyes away from that wild  stare. Look for the virtues of sacred motherhood..... a meek and quiet spirit which is precious in the sight of the  Lord ...... And such virtues you can only find in the daughters of God ...... who, like Leah and Rachel, will build the house of Israel, raising sons and daughters of God.... would worship the Lord and bless His Holy Name..... When you’ve  found such a woman, then you  can truly say......
CHORUS  My love will keep her all the way, At my side she’ll always stay, For we’re united by my promises; I’ll keep my word. She’ll never be alone Together we’ll share our future home, My queen will sit with me upon my throne.

title: BEHOLD THE LAMB
lyrics: About two thousand years ago When John was on the earth, Sent by God to pave the way For the Saviour of this world: And as he introduced the Messiah To the people there, When he saw Jesus coming unto Him, This is what He said.  CHORUS  "Behold the Lamb Who taketh away the sin of this world!" Behold the Lamb Has taken away, has taken away my sin.  Israel suffered serpent stings When they provoked the Lord, God’s mercy caused the brazen serpent To be lifted up; And as for healing, it was lifted In the wilderness, So Jesus Christ was lifted So we could look and live.  In the beginning was the Word, Then, taking fleshly form, Was manifested through Jesus Christ And lifted on the cross: And through the opening of those Seven Seals We see so plain, Just for our redemption, He’s  lifted up again.

title: SAIL ON
lyrics: Morning cometh and also the night, Gross darkness upon the earth; Many are wandering to and fro And knowledge has increased. But make sure your anchor holds my friend, And keep your eyes upon the North Star ’Cause He promised never to leave us; He’s the author and the finisher.  CHORUS  Sail on, sail on, sail on, sail on, Land ahoy! Sail on, sail on, sail on, sail on.  A royal priesthood we are, A peculiar people, A holy generation  That comes from every nation. And the captain of the Lord’s host is on our side, With a flaming sword in His hand To protect us as we go by.  We’ve been travelling six thousand years, Going back to Eden. Soon it wouldn’t be long,  We’ll soon see our Promised Land. Standing fast in the liberty Wherein Christ has made us free, Holding our confession to the end; Lady Liberty.  We’re sailing through rugged, jagged seas With thunders, lightning and blasts; Pressing through with all our might To see God’s Word come to pass. If we perish, we perish, But we’re going to see our King, Laying our lives on the line, Knowing that we are nothing.

title: GOD’S EAGLES
lyrics: I lived in a world of sin and  shame That only caused me grief and      pain, And I tried so hard to be free, Searching for my true identity, Didn’t know I came from  eternity, Until God came and revealed it to me.  CHORUS  On the wings of a        } snow-white Dove,       } God sent His pure       } sweet love,                      } On the wings of a        } snow-white Dove           } To take His eagle        } home.                           }2x  I knew somehow I was born to fly Way up in the sky, But somehow I couldn’t set my wings free; But since that day I heard His  voice And made Him my heavenly choice, By His grace I can say I’ve  been set free.  Now behold what manner of love The Father hath bestowed upon us, That we might be called the Sons of God! Wherever He bids us we will go, Wherever He leads we will  follow, ’Cause who the Son has set free is free indeed.

title: WE ARE HERE TO PRAISE
lyrics: We are here to praise You, To lift our hands and sing. We are here to give You, The best that we can bring; Bringing You our love, Rising from our hearts, Everything within us cries, “I love You Lord.”

title: VICTORY AND GLORY
lyrics: I have heard but now I see, God’s promise to you and me. All these years through thick and thin, We have laboured to enter in. Then God’s silence was broken through and I can see me and you  CHORUS  Singing Victory, Victory and Glory for all eternity, It’s the promise of God to us. Victory and Glory, for all eternity, Hallelujah! Victory and Glory, for all eternity, We’ll sing it forever, Victory and glory for all eternity.  The Thunders came, the Seals revealed, Couldn’t understand all, but yet we believed. Many thought we were off on a limb; But they didn’t know we were worshipping Him. Wednesday the third of June at  Cocoyea God decided to display Himself.    Now we are climbing higher each day, Conquering all devils who stand in our way, This Bride is ready to make her stand For the kingdom of God is at hand, For it becometh unto us to  fulfill all righteousness              This Bride’s revival is here to stay, We must press harder to keep it that way. Through prayer, obedience and sincerity, We’ll all inherit eternity; JVHU, I Jesus, is here to prove that this Bride won’t fail

title: OUR RESTORED FAITH
lyrics: This Message bought us back to oneness with our God, With Seven Seals opening up His Holy Word. Seven Mysteries thundering out and unfolding; Rapturing Faith for Rapturing Grace now revealing.  CHORUS  The Adoption, full Redemption, All authority and power Is restored unto the Bride in this great hour.  I was troubled and confused in Laodicea, No satisfaction for this deep and inward hunger, Clouds of darkness hovered o’er me trying to blind me, The Light broke through, the shadows flew, and now I can see.  I have heard about the inspired declaration, Made by ambassadors for Christ from South in Trinidad, The move is on for the chosen ones by election; The local Bride is gathering in for the adoption.  Seven Voices thundered out in this hour,                                     Revealing Faith to Brotherly Kindness for the Rapture, Anointing hearts and lives with overcoming power; Fear and bondage, skepticism could not linger.  We are quickened by this blessed revelation, Changing from glory unto glory for Redemption, Perfect Love uniting hearts for translation, Perfect Faith conquering death for resurrection.

title: LET GOD HOLD YOUR HAND
lyrics: When you feel that your life is almost gone, And the burdens they are just too much to bear, When you think that my God has left you in your most trying hour, Just remember He’ll be there to hold your hand.  CHORUS  So just let God hold your hand, He never failed and He will not fail, He’ll always be there, So when you think that you’re so alone, My Jesus, He will help you stand, So just let go and let God hold your hand.  Every word that He has promised is true, He has kept me only by His saving grace, So when the pressures of this world engulf you like a mighty sea, He’ll be there, He will be there to hold your hand.  CHORUS  Take my hand precious Lord, lead me home.

title: JESUS NAME
lyrics: Jesus, name above all names, Wonderful Saviour, Glorious Lord, Immanuel, God is with us, Blessed Redeemer, Living Word.

title: MY LORD DELIVERED ME
lyrics: There was a time  when  I was deep in sin, No place in my heart  For the Lord to enter in; Stumbling in darkness, The way I could not find, There was a deep in my soul,  I knew I was blind, Until His light did shine.  CHORUS  My Lord delivered me with His mighty hand, My Lord delivered me from the sinking sand. My Lord delivered me, that is why I sing, My Lord delivered me, I could never stop praising Him.  Now I am a warrior with a battle to fight, I’m not afraid for the Lord my Captain is in sight, He’ll point the Silver Sword and I’ll obey His Word, But the foolish man, he can’t understand, I’m His thought made flesh by predestination.  So here we are so great with child, Resting on that Seventh Peak,  Waiting orders from on high To exercise the Third Pull,  our inheritance; But the wicked man cannot understand, There cannot be any impersonation.  Love one another my brothers,  Let’s run this race, Endure to the end,  For we know we’ll see His face. Grow in grace my sisters,  Let’s fulfill all righteousness, For we are flesh of His flesh and bone of His bone We’ll sit with Him in His throne.

title: HOLDING MY PALM
lyrics:
When I see all Israel in their homeland, When I see all prodigals come home; Then, this evil world, Clothed with darkness in their  soul, Very soon to hear from our Redeemer; The Word-Bride, we are sealed and ready, For the holy new Jerusalem; I am rejoicing and singing,  Shalom! Holding my palm in my hand.  CHORUS  Yes, I am holding my palm in my hand,} 2x Where the eagles are gathered Worshipping the Lamb, I am holding my palm in my hand.  I’m not boasting about much  revelation, I’m not boasting about much inspiration; But when I look in  And miss Elijah from the scene; I believe and fear, for I know who is here; About two hundred pounds  Of olive skinned complexion, Pouring out His fullness unto man; Like John, I shout, Hallelujah! Holding my palm in my hand.  And when I hear God’s Holy Word revealing, All the mysteries of Christ the Son of Man; I recognize my day and what the Spirit says, “Come out of Laodicea;” For the white horse rider will take the hindmost, So come into the Royal Holy Ghost; And the Spirit and the Bride say, “Come, come, come,” Holding my palm in my hand.  And when I feel that hot Shekinah glory, Drawing me deeper into love’s veil; And I feel those flames of light Changing my robes to white, To a place where I could never fail; For it was by predestination, He came to dwell in me, His chosen one; Then let the winds, and the waves, and Satan storm, I am holding my palm in my hand.

title: WE ARE YOUR PEOPLE

lyrics: The hour of shaking is now at hand When many builders would realize They have built on sinking sand. Your great enemy has been conquered;" Fear none of these things that  shall tear this world apart, For the Dove is cooing in our hearts Who are shut up in the ark.

BRIDGE              Unconditional promise for me  and you, Unfailing promise for me and  you, Holy Ghost promise for me and you, Seven Thunders promise for me  and you, Oh, what a mighty promise for me and you.

lyrics: The Lord is my strength and } my song.                                }2x  He has become my salvation, }2x The Lord is my strength  And my song.

He has changed my course from the regions of the lost, that realm of insanity, By anointing my eyes with a Heavenly vision  To behold and live eternally.

I long for the fullness of Eternal Life To share a glory that will never fade away; And I long for my precious new body Where no sickness or pain would ever be again.  I long for full dominion, It’s my inheritance, a son of God I am; I long to go back to Eden, It’s my future home where I’ll  always be.  CHORUS  For there’s just something special about that mountain, Though many valleys to cross He’s more than worth the pain. title: THERE IS NOTHING
lyrics: There is no river, He cannot cross; There is no mountain that’s too tall, That He cannot move; There is no sickness, He cannot heal; There is nothing, no nothing, He cannot do for me.  There is no valley, that is too deep; There is no chain that’s too strong, That I cannot be free; There is no storm He cannot calm; There is nothing, no nothing, He cannot do for me.

title: HE IS MORE THAN ABLE
lyrics: He is able, more than able, To accomplish what concerns me today. He is able, more than able To handle anything that comes my way. He is able, more than able To do much more than I could ever dream, He is  able, more  than able To make me what He wants me to be.

title: * LIVING EPISTLES
lyrics: We are eyewitnesses of His majesty, We have seen the Lord fulfilling His Word; And we know we are God’s characters in this great symphony, As we act on the things That we have seen and we have heard.  CHORUS  How else can we live, forever praising Him,                                                 For we are living epistles read  of all men; You are Almighty God in flesh again, That’s who we are, Living epistles read of all men, You are to me, Almighty God in flesh again.  We’ve been made a spectacle to  this world today, The Life of Jesus being on  display; Our resurrected Christ.                Awaken Jesus to the scene again, As He glorifies His Name once again in His children.  Let’s press on daily with the King’s Sword in our hand, Defeating the enemy on every  hand; So ride on Thy Majesty to Thy  rightful place On the throne of our hearts; Of this kingdom, He rose us up to be a part.  We know that today the Word is in the Bride It’s Jesus again on His second ride; Let’s bring our King, our rejected King, A clean fresh drink, By living worthy of this gospel         We worship Him.

title: LET US DRAW NEAR
lyrics: Are we weak and troubled or in deep despair? Is the avenger of the soul on our trail? Well, the Name of our Lord is a Mighty tower That the righteous can run into and be safe.  CHORUS  Let us draw near with a true heart In full assurance of faith; That we find grace and  strength to help In time of need.  It took a perfect sacrifice before We could ever attain to  perfect faith; That’s why Christ the perfect Lamb, The atonement came, And to the Holiest of Holies, He cleared the way.  CHORUS  So let us draw near having our hearts Sprinkled by His blood, For now we have free access To the throne of God.  We were not made angels, we’re of mortal kind, And we daily make mistakes for we are weak, But we have not a High Priest  who cannot be touched With the feelings of our infirmities.

title: I DON’T KNOW WHAT I’D DO
lyrics: I don’t know what I’d do,  I don’t know what I’d do,  I don’t know what I’d do without the Lord; When I look around and see, All that He has done for me, I don’t know what I’d do without the Lord.

title: THE NIGHT VISION
lyrics:
I beheld in the night vision, O’er the great sea of humanity, Creeping things, detestable things Rising and gathering around me From my soul came a desperate cry, ‘Lord hide me from this hell I see, I want to live with You eternally!’  CHORUS  I cried, “Hide me Rock of ages, Separate me from the evils of  this life, Cover me with Thy robe of  purity, Be Lord of my life.”  Then I lifted my eyes towards Heaven, Lo, a Mighty Angel came down; One foot on land and one upon sea, And His face shone like the sun; When He spoke His voice was like thunder, And a mystery was made clear; For the Voice that thundered judgement Whispered freedom in my ear.  I considered the voice of the Angel, Whose sayings were faithful and true, Saying, “I Jesus is the Word of God That has come to redeem you; Through the Angel in the pulpit, Cause this man to understand He would live and reign eternally.”  CHORUS  I cried, “Thank Thee, Rock of ages, You’ve separated me from the evils of this life, You have covered me with Thy robe of purity, You are Lord of my life.”  I was lifted amidst a great multitude In the air above the sea, A new song they sang no man could learn, Shouting praise for victory; Saying, “Worthy is the Lamb,
Who has given us power to overcome, We now live and we'll reign eternally.”  I heard a great voice saying, “Come up hither, To the great supper of the Lamb Prepared by God for those whom He foreknew Before the world began, Saying, “Enter the joys of the Lord My beloved Bride, Come sit with Me,  I just want you at My side.”

title: FILL   ME
lyrics: Dear Lord, I know You called me, And I’m baptized in Your Name; Yet there is this promise You have made, So  Lord, I am asking you To fulfill Your Word  that You would fill me with the Holy Ghost.  CHORUS  I’m asking You to fill me with the Holy Spirit, Fill me, fill me with Your love; So Lord, it would not just be a part, But a circumcision of my whole heart, There’ll be no difference in  my standing and my state; I’m asking You to fill me.  For me to live this Christian life This old man must die For Your Spirit to abide; Lord, I don’t want reformation, But a Holy Ghost transfusion, For You have said that I must be born again.  Lord, I see the challenge is rising, And so many amongst us are  falling, Shows me Lord, I need  another touch, If You should come and live in me I’ll be having constant victory By the faith that overcomes the world.

title: THE SWORD OF THE LORD
lyrics:
Arise thou mighty man of valour and brave the fight, Victory is in thy favour go in this thy might, The Midianites are running, It’s spiritual Armageddon; Shout, “the Sword of the Lord and of Gideon!” Yes, the Spirit of Gideon is on  me, Yes, the Spirit of the Lord is anointing me.  Dig deeper in those mysteries,  Let your seven locks grow long; Oh anointing of Samson,  Let faith  muscles become strong; Lord, lead me to those pillars,  Let me cast those devils down, Let me hear those Seven Thunders sound; For the Spirit of Samson is on  me, Yes, the Spirit of the Lord is anointing me.  “Speak now my fair lady,  Touch the scepter in my hand; Make known your desires  It’s my pleasure to command.” “Lord, my people, they are dying, They must have their liberty; Let me go and set the captive  free.” For the Spirit of Esther is on me; Yes, the Spirit of the Lord is anointing me.  “You have followed me this far,  What can I do for you?” “Let a double portion of Your spirit rest upon me too.” “You ask a hard thing but if you see me go, The power of the Lord you shall know.” For the Spirit of Elisha is on me, Yes, the Spirit of the Lord is anointing me.  Arise, you moping eagles,
Cease hopping on the ground, Can’t you hear your brother screaming? There’s virtue in that sound.  Arise and eat, be strengthened, For this journey you must be  strong, You were born to set your eyes on the Sun. For the Spirit of the Eagle is on me, Yes, the Spirit of the Lord is anointing me.  “Arise, thou mighty men of valour  and brave the fight, Victory is in thy favour go in this thy might;” The Midianites are running, it’s spiritual Armageddon,  Shout the Sword of the Lord    } and of Gideon.                         } 8x

title: CONSIDER HIM
lyrics: I have to sing to you About the One who died for me, Even though I’ve failed, Yet His Love’s still being  expressed to me; In my time of trial and when the enemy assails, I draw back just for a little while To consider Him.  CHORUS  Consider Him who for the joy endured the cross, Consider Him who died for all  that was lost; Consider Him who there on Calvary bore your pain, I want you just for a little while To consider Him.  I know that life is rough, sometimes the trials hard to bear, And your daily life is encumbered with a load of care; Then there are those times when you can’t seem to bear the strain, I want you just for a little while To consider Him.

title: SPEAK AND DON’T DOUBT
lyrics: Speak and don’t doubt,  Just believe in your heart, Speak and don’t doubt,  Till His Word comes to pass, Whatever thing you desire in your soul, You just believe that my Lord, He will perform.  CHORUS  Joshua spake to the sun,  And he said, “sun stand still.” It’s all because he knew who he was, Bride let us speak His Word Having known who we are; Revelation 10: 8-11: that’s who we are.  We have arrived at that junction in His Word, We have arrived where something must give way; The faith of God that is locked up in our hearts, We’ll speak this very Word;  We’ll see His glory pass.  Our prophet spoke and he believed the Word, Our prophet spoke and squirrels did appear; God’s redeemed Church has reached up to that sphere, Inside that little room where the power cannot fail.  Enter in there where the Light went in that room, Enter in there where the Angel said He’ll meet you; You’ll come out whole, with your crutches in your hand, Leaping and praising God for there’s power in that room.

title: LET ME BE A SACRIFICE
lyrics: Let me be a sacrifice, holy and acceptable, Let me be a sacrifice, consumed in Your praise, Let me be a sacrifice, holy and acceptable, Let me be a sacrifice, worshipping Your Name.

title: THAT’S WHY I CALL HIM
lyrics: I was taken from His side When my Lord bled and died, The earth shook, and all of nature’s pillars cried. I’m a new creation, I’m His flesh, I’m His spirit, I’m His bones, And I’ll tell the world He’s Lord, And we two are one.  Several times I’ve let Him down, But my slide made His love more strong, From His side flowed reconciling love, Such a Love the world don’t know; Such a Love it could never show; It took the Dove to bring it down from up above.  For a sign, just to show the world That my Gene was celestial, From His side royal blood did flow Oh, the serpent’s head was crushed well done, Hallelujah to God’s Holy One! Who by His blood has brought me back to my God.  In this time of the catching away, Down here in this world His Bride won't stay She'll be taken up and all the sleeping saints will wake But before her change  She'll have perfect faith and the Third Pull will be displayed To show this world God's promise is sure, He cannot fail

title: JESUS  OH JESUS
lyrics: Jesus, oh Jesus,  Won’t You move among us here and free us.  Free us, oh free us To lay down our lives in love and worship You.

lyrics: CHORUS  Jehovah Nissi, the Lord our banner;                          Jehovah Rapha, the Lord our healer;                                  Jehovah Shalom, the Lord our peace;                             Jehovah Shammah, the Lord is present;                          Jehovah Raah, the Lord our shepherd;                          Jehovah Tsidkenu, the Lord our righteousness;                  Jehovah Shalom, the Lord our peace;                              Jehovah Jireh, He provideth all our needs.                                                                                                                                                         Lord I want to take the time, Just to praise Your Holy Name, ’Cause You’ve been, been so good to me;  So from the rising of the sun,     To the going down of the same,  Lord Your Name alone is worthy to be praised.                                 You are the great I AM that I AM, The God that was, is, and is to come,  Prophet, Priest and King,  Eagle, Lamb and Lion, Son of Man, Son of God and Son of David.  You are the Rose of Sharon, You’re the Lily of the valley, You’re the Bright and Morning Star, That’s who You are; The Mighty Conqueror that’s been unconquered by traditions,  The Lord God Jehovah is His name.

lyrics: Jesus, I just want to Praise You,}3x Praise You for being so good.  Jesus, I just want  to serve You ... Jesus, I just want to thank You .... Jesus, I just want to love You ......

lyrics: We have seen the Lord In the fulfillment of His Word. He promised through the prophet to return, To ride this trail again, to reveal His New Name; To teach His Bride to prophesy again.  CHORUS  Coming from the east, coming from the west, Coming from the north and from the south; All the rainbow trouts are gathered by the Shout; For adoption on the summit of the Seventh Peak. A Rainbow-covenanted One,  In the Joshua Commission Testifies “She has turned at the west,” With the authority for her ministry, And she shall speak from the Summit of the Seventh Peak.  We sing a brand new song, We are the blood-washed throng, We’ve seen our names beneath the Seventh Seal. He opened up to us all the mysteries, And there’s light now on the Summit of the Seventh Peak.  All things are ready now  Father let the fire fall Father glorify thy name,  You did it once before  In the life of Malachi 4 Now Father glorify your name
